records.title: Sexual-offence investigation — Narrabeen walking tracks
records.summary: NSW Police appealed for information after multiple alleged sexual touching incidents on walking trails in the Narrabeen area. CCTV images were later released of a male police said may be able to assist. This marker represents the publicly reported incident area, not a person's residence.
